answer: To Sybil, an attacker needs N distinct prisms plus N stakes, and the summit of reputation is only reached after sustained epoch participation, so fake identities stay low-trust and their staked value is slashed on collusion detection, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique relic token minted from a verified hardware prism at registration, binding identity to one physical device. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
